dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING, file paths under /var/tmp/, no COMP-3, no EXEC CICS/SQL
evidence: no EXEC CICS, no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical insurance receipt (shinryo-hoshu) combination processing - patient insurance registration and combination creation for health insurance and public expense (kouhi) coverage
purpose.summary: This program (ORCGP02W2) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt system. It handles patient insurance registration and the creation/validation of insurance combination records (hoken kumiai-se), including national health insurance, public expense subsidies, and long-term care combinations. It is a batch/subprogram component called by higher-level ORCA screens.

notable_features: 14 COPY statements with REPLACING clauses (copybook-heavy modular design)
12 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
230 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (flat-file / DB access via CALLed modules)
Extensive Japanese comments in EUC-JP encoding (decoded as latin-1)
Revision history spanning 2000-2006 with named developers (MCC, NACL)
OCCURS 99 tables for insurance and public expense combinations
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial/insurance COBOL)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese, appearing as mojibake in the snippet. This is standard for JMA ORCA source files. The program is clearly production-grade healthcare software with a detailed revision history. Truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 242KB / 5084 lines.
